QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Source of the Rumor
QuestInfo.0: Elva, the owner of the General Store, overheard your conversation and has something to contribute.
QuestInfo.1: Elva, the owner of the General Store, says the store is a gathering place for conversation and rumor. One of her customers mentioned seeing a stranger in the forest around that time and described something similar to what Aruhi saw.
